title: Scheduled tasks
empty: No scheduled tasks yet. Create one with "New scheduled task".
selectHint: Select a scheduled task, or create a new one.
deleteDetail: The task stops running; its past runs are kept. A run already in progress is unaffected and finishes normally.
deleteConfirm: Delete scheduled task "{{name}}"? Conversations it already created are kept.

form.title: Scheduled task
form.name: Name
form.modelsEmpty: No models are enabled. Enable one on the Models page first.
form.timezoneHint: The clock the trigger times are read on. Leave it on this machine's zone to follow the computer running the task; if that cannot be read, Asia/Shanghai is used.
form.sessionExistingHint: Each run continues that same conversation, so it can build on what earlier runs did. Nothing is compacted for you — compact it yourself if it gets long.
form.sessionRetentionHint: Delete the run's conversation once it settles, success or failure. The run's status, summary and full output stay on the run.
form.dateRequired: Pick the date to run on.
form.timeRequired: Pick the time to run at.
form.shortMonthHint: Months without this day run on the last day of the month.
form.fullPermissionWarning: Scheduled tasks run with full permission and never prompt for approval.
form.cwdRequired: A workspace conversation needs a working directory.
form.conversationModeHint: A chat conversation appears under Chat and brings its own temporary working directory — nothing to set. A workspace conversation is filed under its working directory, so it needs one.
form.cwdPlaceholder: Pick a folder, or type a path

runSessionDeleted: This run's conversation was deleted as configured; the output is saved on the run (still readable with future task output).
